_comment: Maps 3-letter airport codes (as they appear in the DEP/DES columns of a flight schedule) to IANA timezone names, used to convert the schedule's UTC STD into the local STD (LT) printed on the LIR. This list covers the stations seen so far; extend it as new routes appear. If a flight's departure airport is missing from this table, generate_lir.py will NOT guess -- it falls back to the UTC time and flags the flight in its warnings so a human can add the mapping.
